_comment: Baked-Perf-Fix-Pipeline M2d (Vixen-Docs/01-Architecture/Baked-Perf-Fix-Pipeline-Plan-2026-07.md). Two modes: same_path is a HARD GATE for every milestone from M2d onward (bit-exact virtual==baked is impossible by construction, so this checks a run against its own golden, not the two providers against each other). cross_path is REPORT-ONLY until M5's baked-lighting-parity work closes the known virtual<->baked lighting divergence -- 'enforced' flips true only when M5 marks it so in this file.

same_path._comment: Golden vs a fresh same-provider run (e.g. baked vs baked). Tolerance is <=2 of 625 cells, widened from the initial hash-equality per this file's own documented procedure, WITH the observed run pair cited: 2026-07-16, golden (worktree-binary, HEAD d3a212f6) vs main-binary (merge 0daf4f29) flipped exactly ONE cell -- map row 21, the floor(3)/right-wall(1) grazing-corner near-tie pixel first documented by the M2 validator. Main-binary runs are byte-identical to each other (A/B verified) -- the flip is a stable cross-binary compile difference (FMA/rounding), not run-to-run jitter. bodies_match and oob checks remain HARD requirements; the tamper failure signature (single-body corruption) measured 9/625 cells + bodies_match=False, so <=2 cells cannot mask it. If a future pair exceeds 2 cells, that is a REAL failure -- do not widen again without the same class of evidence.

cross_path._comment: Baked vs virtual. ENFORCED at M5b (2026-07-17) once the backWall far-hit root cause was fixed (non-unit instDir into the ESVO ray setup at renderScale!=1 -- TraceWorld.glsl; see Baked-Perf-Fix-Pipeline-Plan-2026-07.md M5b). Budgets set from the MEASURED post-fix cross-path numbers with regression margin: cell_agreement 99.0%, run_a(baked) OOB 0/183540, luminance mean-abs 4.70, p99 40.77, pct-over-threshold 7.9%. The LOAD-BEARING far-hit fences are instidx_agreement_pct_target + run_a_oob_fraction_max: those are the metrics the far-hit corrupted (agreement 95->99, OOB 28%->0). The luminance p99/mean-abs budgets are DELIBERATELY loose regression fences, NOT a parity target -- p99 measured 38.77 WITH the far-hits and 40.77 WITHOUT, i.e. it never tracked the corruption; the residual ~40 p99 is baked-normal-quality on the subdiv=1 small bodies (sphere/box/light render dimmer than virtual's analytic normals -- M5's cause 2, a Phase-2 bake-resolution item, NOT the far-hit). Do not tighten the luminance budgets to force 'parity' without that Phase-2 bake work; do keep them tight enough that a returning far-hit (which spikes OOB + drops agreement) fails here.
